query: SELECT year, campus, subgroup, SUM(volunteerCount) as vol_checkins FROM attendance_weekly WHERE year = 2026 AND subgroup != 'Volunteers' AND volunteerCount > 0 GROUP BY year, campus, subgroup ORDER BY vol_checkins DESC LIMIT 15;
